fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip' on user profile update

files_to_modify.fixed_code: user["phone"] = updates["phone"].strip() if updates["phone"] is not None else None
files_to_modify.rationale: Calling strip() on optional phone parameter when set to None

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/services/user_service.py
+++ b/app/services/user_service.py
@@ -21,7 +21,7 @@
     if "name" in updates:
         user["name"] = updates["name"].strip()

     if "phone" in updates:
-        user["phone"] = updates["phone"].strip()
+        user["phone"] = updates["phone"].strip() if updates["phone"] is not None else None
     return user
fix_plan.rationale: Calling strip() on optional phone parameter when set to None
